support_claim: MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as its counterparty, billing records bill Meridian Energy Partners LLC, and commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides direct documentary linkage—not mere name compatibility—establishing that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and the counterparty denoted by contract:MSA-MER-2024 are the same legal counterparty; the packet does not preserve alternate candidates or flag missing identity information.
